subject: Winthrop Street Bike Lanes Phase II
overview: The commission approved a parking opt-out for Spencer Road and a handicap sign on Woods Road, but tabled a major bike lane and safety project for the Winthrop Street corridor to address concerns regarding the rotary and residential parking.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Tabled the minutes of the February meeting to clarify the recorded description of a previous parking petition.

items.title: Spencer Road Opt-Out Petition
items.summary: Approved the petition for Spencer Road to be removed from the Green Line Extension (GLX) resident permit parking area following unanimous support from the affected homeowners.

items.title: Handicap Parking Sign: 51 Woods Road
items.summary: Approved a request for a designated handicap parking sign at 51 Woods Road based on medical necessity and local parking challenges.

items.title: Winthrop Street Bike Lanes Phase II
items.summary: Tabled the Phase II proposal for Winthrop Street to allow staff to re-evaluate the removal of right-turn slip lanes at the rotary and the loss of residential parking. Residents and commissioners expressed concern over increased traffic congestion, the aesthetics of flex posts in residential areas, and the safety of cyclists navigating the high-collision rotary.
